feeds.title: Child and Family Blog
feeds.description: We work with the world's leading researchers on children and families to tell the stories that new research is telling. We want to share the new knowledge that researchers create worldwide with all those who can influence the quality of care for children, in particular, people who make policy and professionals who care for families and children.

feeds.title: The Center for Child Development Blog
feeds.description: We are a private practice focused on the emotional and mental health needs of children and their families. We work to help children improve their behavior, express emotions appropriately, and help parents to feel confident in their parenting skills.

feeds.title: Child Development Institute
feeds.description: Become the awesome parent your child needs with expert articles and great tips about child development and early childhood development from Child Development Institute. Our mission is to enable parents to provide the nurture and support to meet the unique needs of a child so they will reach their true potential.

feeds.title: Developing Minds Blog
feeds.description: Helping kids & teens feel calm, confident, cooperative and cope with challenges. We are a group of psychologists, who specialise in working with kids, teens and young adults.

feeds.title: Dr. Gil Tippy's Child Development Blog
feeds.description: Gil Tippy has lived and worked on the North Shore of Long Island, in New York, for the last 30 years. A graduate of Cornell University, he was a teacher of kids and young adults. He graduated from Columbia University with a Masters Degree in Developmental Psychology, and Long Island University/Post with a Doctorate in Clinical Psychology.

feeds.title: In-sync Blog
feeds.description: In-Sync Center for Child Development has been established with the aim of bringing a world-class comprehensive approach and intervention to children in India. Follow to get updates from this blog.

feeds.title: The Early Childhood Blog
feeds.description: Follow MUSKAAN JAITIC blog for child development posts.

feeds.title: Threysol Blog
feeds.description: The blog brings to light the experience of the specialist from a specific area (Developmental Pediatrician in the current series) and educates fellow professionals and parents on the topics. The topics are gathered from the queries/interactions with the parents. Threya focuses on collaborative goal setting and enables the holistic development of the child.

feeds.title: ScreenStrong Blog
feeds.description: Covers easy education on brain development, the effects of screen use on kids, and solutions for parents who desire to free their kids from screen addictions. Melanie Hempe helps parents reclaim their kids by delaying the use of toxic screens and reconnecting families.

feeds.title: Bright Horizons
feeds.description: Learn about child development & education for kids of all ages. Our blog offers advice about child behavior, learning, emotional development & more.

feeds.title: Advanced Psychology Services
feeds.description: Welcome to child development and parenting blog by psychologist Dr. Tali Shenfield. In this blog, you will find hundreds of articles and resources on various topics incl. parenting of special needs children.

feeds.title: Brightlobe Blog
feeds.description: We're building a game-based neurodevelopmental assessment to support child development. Magical, immersive experiences that help children reach their potential. We're a games studio making an impact in healthcare + education.

feeds.title: Child Development Advice
feeds.description: Michelle Dell'Aquila is the Director of the Child Development Advice program. She has a Master's Degree in Special Education and is NY State Certified to teach early childhood education both in mainstream and special ed classrooms.
